review_note: Pinned lemma 8259 says if ONE finite polynomial presentation of a finite-type A→B has Koszul-regular kernel then EVERY such presentation does. Both existence and universality are preserved.
original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-koszul-independence-presentation}
Let $A \to B$ be a finite type ring map. If for some presentation
$\alpha : A[x_1, \ldots, x_n] \to B$ the kernel $I$ is a Koszul-regular ideal
then for any presentation $\beta : A[y_1, \ldots, y_m] \to B$ the kernel
$J$ is a Koszul-regular ideal.

review_note: Pinned lemma 8347 states the lci property is local on a finite principal open cover of S given by elements generating 1. The draft preserves the requirement all R→S_gj are lci.
original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-lci-local}
Let $R \to S$ be a ring map. Let $g_1, \ldots, g_m \in S$
generate the unit ideal. If each $R \to S_{g_j}$ is a local
complete intersection so is $R \to S$.

review_note: Pinned lemma 8458 contains a conormal differential diagram and extended Jacobi–Zariski six-term exact sequence under lci B→C. The draft leaves NL and L notation unintroduced while referring to external exact-sequence conventions; without independently reviewed definitions and maps its standalone equivalence is unverified.
original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-transitive-lci-at-end}
Let $A \to B \to C$ be ring maps. Assume $B \to C$ is a local complete
intersection homomorphism. Choose a presentation
$\alpha : A[x_s, s \in S] \to B$ with kernel $I$. Choose a presentation
$\beta : B[y_1, \ldots, y_m] \to C$ with kernel $J$. Let
$\gamma : A[x_s, y_t] \to C$ be the induced presentation of $C$ with kernel
$K$. Then we get a canonical commutative diagram
$$
\xymatrix{
0 \ar[r] &
\Omega_{A[x_s]/A} \otimes C \ar[r] &
\Omega_{A[x_s, y_t]/A} \otimes C \ar[r] &
\Omega_{B[y_t]/B} \otimes C \ar[r] &
0 \\
0 \ar[r] &
I/I^2 \otimes C \ar[r] \ar[u] &
K/K^2 \ar[r] \ar[u] &
J/J^2 \ar[r] \ar[u] &
0
}
$$
with exact rows. In particular, the six term exact sequence of
Algebra, Lemma \ref{algebra-lemma-exact-sequence-NL}
can be completed with a zero on the left, i.e., the sequence
$$
0 \to H_1(\NL_{B/A} \otimes_B C) \to
H_1(L_{C/A}) \to
H_1(L_{C/B}) \to
\Omega_{B/A} \otimes_B C \to
\Omega_{C/A} \to
\Omega_{C/B} \to 0
$$
is exact.
hold_reason: NL and L cotangent objects and the referenced six-term sequence are not defined sufficiently for independent source-first verification of the standalone diagram.
proposed_correction: Recover allowed notation declarations of NL and L and individually check exactness of presentation diagram and extended sequence.

review_note: Pinned lemma 8523 asserts cohomology isomorphisms after base-changing the naive cotangent complex NL to henselizations and strict henselizations. The draft does not clarify NL notation or the strict-henselization choice conventions referenced externally.
original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-henselization-NL}
Let $A \to B$ be a local homomorphism of local rings.
Let $A^h \to B^h$, resp.\ $A^{sh} \to B^{sh}$ be the induced
map on henselizations, resp.\ strict henselizations
(Algebra, Lemma \ref{algebra-lemma-henselian-functorial},
resp.\ Lemma \ref{algebra-lemma-strictly-henselian-functorial}).
Then $\NL_{B/A} \otimes_B B^h \to \NL_{B^h/A^h}$ and
$\NL_{B/A} \otimes_B B^{sh} \to \NL_{B^{sh}/A^{sh}}$
induce isomorphisms on cohomology groups.
hold_reason: Undefined NL and strict henselization functoriality and choices make the exported formulation context-dependent.
proposed_correction: Supply source-safe definitions of the cotangent notation and compatible strict-henselization maps before re-review.
